extDescription.message: Your phone becomes the remote for any video in this browser: skip intros, jump back, pause and go fullscreen from the sofa.

setupIntro.message: Optional: pair this browser with the Skipper app on your phone. Skipping from this browser works without it.

stepRelayHint.message: Leave empty and it works as is, over the public MQTT broker. Add your own relay for the faster WebRTC, WebSocket and HTTP paths, e.g. wss://relay.example.com.

stepCodeHint.message: Generated for you. The phone needs the same code — the QR code carries it.

invalidRelay.message: Must start with ws:// or wss://

waitingSub.message: Open Skipper on your phone and pick this browser.

offlineSub.message: Check the relay address under Settings.

noTargetHint.message: Commands go to the tab playing a video, or the active tab.

pairHint.message: Scan with your phone's camera to add this browser to Skipper.

newCodeConfirm.message: A new code disconnects phones paired with the old one. Continue?

weakCode.message: Short code: whoever runs the relay or a public broker could guess it.

updateImportantBody.message: It contains important fixes: install it as soon as you can.

updateSteps.message: Unzip it into the folder Skipper is loaded from, replacing the files. Then press Reload — your pairing and settings are kept.

setupNoApp.message: No Skipper app on your phone yet?

aboutRemote.message: The Skipper app on your phone is the remote. This extension receives its commands and carries them out on the tab playing a video: jump, play/pause, fullscreen.

aboutPaths.message: A browser can only be reached over the internet, so commands travel through your relay server or an MQTT broker. Each one is signed with the pairing code: nobody without it can send commands.

aboutFullscreen.message: During a fullscreen command Chrome briefly shows a “debugging this browser” bar. That's the extension pressing the player's fullscreen button for you, because a page only goes fullscreen when a person asks.

skipIndependent.message: Works on its own, no phone needed. With a phone connected, both do the same jump on the same video.

optOverlayHint.message: The look picked above. Off leaves only the shortcuts.

optKeysHint.message: Every shortcut needs Alt, Ctrl or Win, so the site's own keys keep working.

shortcutsHint.message: Click Change, then press the keys you want. Esc cancels.

problem_needsModifier.message: Add Alt, Ctrl or Win, or typing would trigger it.

problem_altGr.message: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on many keyboards.

style_pills_d.message: Back and forward on the video's edges. Hover one to pick the amount.

style_dock_d.message: One slim tab on the edge that opens into buttons and amounts.

style_gesture_d.message: No buttons. Hold Alt and scroll over the video to skip.

style_timeline_d.message: No buttons. Shortcuts or Alt + scroll, and a bar that shows where you landed.

tip_pills.message: Hover a pill to pick the amount · {key} skips forward

tip_dock.message: Hover the tab for buttons and amounts · {key} skips forward

tip_gesture.message: Hold Alt and scroll over the video to skip · {key} works too

tip_timeline.message: Press {key} to skip, or hold Alt and scroll over the video

introTitle.message: New: skip right on the video

introBody.message: Move the pointer over any video. Pick how it looks and works in the Settings tab.

skipRestoreAsk.message: Replace your amounts with the defaults?

logHint.message: Sends the extension log to the developer. It lists what the extension did and when; it never contains your pair code.
